name: István Kovács
bio:
István's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for engines, fueled by his grandfather's stories of working on tractors in the Hungarian countryside. He pursued a vocational degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision machining. Eager to apply his skills, István sought an entry-level position within a race team, where he could contribute to the creation of high-performance components. 

István approaches his work with a pragmatic mindset. He believes in the power of detailed work and efficient solutions. While he's still developing his technical expertise, István is a quick learner and dedicated to mastering the intricacies of motorsport machining. His ambition lies in becoming a highly skilled machinist capable of crafting parts that push the boundaries of performance and reliability.

Though an entry-level machinist, his perfectionist nature is already shining through, ensuring that every component he works on meets the highest standards.

physical.description: István is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always carries a small, well-worn machinist's handbook.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers on surfaces while deep in thought.
Insists on cleaning his workspace meticulously at the end of each day.
